'''Anx Minor''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Anx Minor system/Legends|Anx Minor system]], a part of the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Sinsang system/Legends|Sinsang system]] as well as the [[Ord Trasi system/Legends|Ord Trasi system]] in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route connected Anx Minor to [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that at one point [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] neighboring [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Anx Space]] region.<ref name="Gamer7">{{GamerCite|7|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx}}</ref>

Anx Minor was situated in the territory of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when that faction was absorbed by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The celestial body remained within the borders of the Imperial Remnant until [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], following a [[Battle of Ketaris (17 ABY)|victory]] at [[Ketaris/Legends|Ketaris]], [[New Republic Third Fleet|forces]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|commanded]] by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] triumphed over a force led by Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the Imperial Remnant in a [[Battle of Anx Minor|confrontation]] at Anx Minor.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Anx Minor was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Anx Minor in grid square L-4.<ref name="TEA" />
